decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's existing garage door business and the operator line can be improved through related mechanical and production knowledge.
Solid wood sectional doors are outside the firm's metal fabrication core and lack the wood-processing knowledge needed to assimilate and improve the product.
As a remote-control variant of the operator line, it leverages the same electromechanical knowledge as Product A and can be improved through shared learning.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a direct extension of the firm's existing industrial door range, so early results can be readily interpreted and the product improved.
Insulated glazed industrial sectional doors combine the firm's existing glazing and insulation capabilities, giving it high absorptive capacity to refine the product.
This glazed industrial sectional door is closely related to established products and has dedicated market presence, indicating early results are clear enough to justify continued investment.
